decisions.title: Evergreen Dependency Model
decisions.rule: Target current stable runtimes (Node 24+, Python 3.12+). Deprecated packages and deprecation warnings are fatal build errors (Zero Warnings).

decisions.title: Domain Isolation (WHAT ⟂ HOW)
decisions.rule: Never mix environments/ (WHAT) and design_system/ (HOW) in one Change Set. Never hand-edit build/staging/**.

decisions.title: Evidence Gate / Zero Hallucination
decisions.rule: No invented tokens, CSS classes, DOM nodes, entities, or plugins. Missing Source of Truth → FATAL_EXCEPTION / HALT.

decisions.title: GitOps Agent Boundary
decisions.rule: Agent boundary ends at Git. Forbidden: publish_edge.sh, SSH writes, ad-hoc Edge copies, local deploy scripts. CI alone publishes to Edge on main.

decisions.title: MCP Control Plane Execution Harness
decisions.rule: Agents MUST prefer m2m-ha-glass-harness typed Tools, Resources, and Prompts. Load STD via index + path-scoped domain files only — never the full STD corpus in one turn.

decisions.title: Observability, Golden Evals & Risk Gates
decisions.rule: Golden Intent evals gate harness regressions. MCP tools are risk-classified (READ_ONLY / LOCAL_MUTATION / CRITICAL_DEPLOY). LOCAL_MUTATION requires gates_passed=true. Edge CD runs a 60s REST canary with auto-rollback.

decisions.title: Tier-3 Visual LLM-as-a-Judge Eval Harness
decisions.rule: Visual & semantic LLM-as-a-Judge (DeepEval or equivalent) remains unauthorized until explicitly activated. Tier 1 schema/policy and Tier 2 Playwright sandbox remain binding.

decisions.title: VCS & Execution Governance
decisions.rule: Sync with main before new work; mutate only on <class>/<kebab-description> task branches; never develop on main. Fail-fast on first environment restriction.

decisions.title: Experience Memory Bank
decisions.rule: Read .agent/lessons.md before shell/env work. Capture resolved environment failures with Symptom / Operational Reality / Correct Action. Promote multi-cycle lessons during scheduled review.

decisions.title: Thin Instructions; Bounded STD SoT
decisions.rule: IDE .mdc / .cursorrules hold role, gates, and STD indices — never full constraint prose. Machine SoT is the bounded tree _local_ai/memory/ltm/std/ (index.json + core + domains). docs/adr/ is a legacy narrative archive. Monolithic std_decisions.json is forbidden.
